messages:
anna: heads up — after shipping py/ts SDK patch v1.12.3 we started seeing weird routing attribution in the console. apps using the new SDKs show traffic routed to the fallback model and quota charged there even though requests say route=preferred.

mike: can you paste an example request/headers? wondering if header casing/encoding changed. :thinking_face:

anna: here's a cutdown curl we used to repro:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'X-Route: preferred' \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

sophia: curious — console shows routehint=preferred for that tenant or just quota attribution to fallback?

anna: console shows routehint=preferred in traces but quota ledger increments on fallback pool ID. attaching the debug span id: span: r-3b9f.

raj: I pulled the span logs. I see the SDK is sending `x-route` but our gateway normalizes to `X-Route`. In the new TS client we started lowercasing headers in the internal proxy shim. That could break header matching in the router.

tim: we intentionally added header canonicalization to avoid duplicates. but the routing policy matcher looks for exact-case header keys because of a fast-path map lookup. oops.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: routing-fix-hotpatch -> canary (3 instances) by tim at 6173000100

mike: quick mitigation: SDK patch to stop canonicalizing header keys (revert behavior) and release a new patch to py/ts. Also add router fallback to case-insensitive match — we'll need to coordinate.

sophia: agree. short-term: add tolerant matching in the gateway (case-insensitive map lookup) + telemetry flag so we can opt-in and validate no regressions. Long-term: update policy matcher tests and add a note to console docs about header canonicalization guarantees.

anna: I can cut a quick PR for a py patch and a changelog note. can someone own the gateway change?

raj: I can do the gateway tolerance change and add a unit test. will also add a metric `routing.header_case_mismatch` so ops can see how many requests relied on tolerant matching.

tim: can we add a console dashboard tile showing route vs quota mismatch by tenant? would help OSS when we roll out the fix.

sophia: yes — I'll sketch a small dashboard: columns tenant, expected_route, charged_pool, mismatch_count last 24h. add alert if mismatch_rate > 0.5%.

anna: plan: (1) revert SDK canonicalization patch -> py/ts patch release within 4 hours (2) gateway case-insensitive matcher deploy canary now (deploy-bot says started) (3) add metric and console tile, watch for 24h. tagging stakeholders: @mike @sophia @raj @tim

mike: thumbs up. once SDK patch is out we should coordinate a brief blog note in release notes about header handling to avoid confusion for integrators. :white_check_mark:

raj: PR link (gateway tolerant match): https://git.redwood/infradev/routers/pull/432

anna: thanks all — will post updates here after SDK releases and when canary shows lower mismatch. :raised_hands:
